description: This file defines key handling utilities for keyboard shortcuts, including normalization of key names, modifier handling, and a keydown event handler function.

methods.name: normalizeKeyName
methods.description: Normalizes a key name string by parsing modifiers and special keys.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Creates a normalized copy of a key-command mapping object.

methods.name: modifiers
methods.description: Generates a key name string with modifiers based on keyboard event and shift flag.

methods.name: keydownHandler
methods.description: Returns a function that handles keydown events based on provided key-command bindings.
